name: Dialtidy – International Phone Number Field & Validation for WooCommerce
author: wedoingood

sections.description:
Customers type their phone number the way they are used to, for example (201) 555-0123. Without a country code, you can’t tell where that number belongs, and calls, text messages and couriers fail.

Dialtidy adds a country picker with flags to the phone field. The country of the address is preselected, the customer can pick another one, and the order gets the number in international format: +12015550123.

Features

  • Works in the block checkout, the classic checkout and the addresses in My account.
  • The country of the billing or shipping address is preselected and changes with the address until the customer types a number or picks a country.
  • Customers type the number as usual: spaces, dashes and parentheses, a leading 0, 00 or the country code with or without +, and digits from other scripts are all understood.
  • Numbers are saved in international format (E.164), for example +12015550123, ready for couriers and text messages.
  • On the order screen the number is shown with spaces, for example +1 201-555-0123, and can be called with one click.
  • Each phone field has its own country list: all countries, the countries you sell or ship to, or your own selection. You can also block countries.
  • Countries you choose, such as your customers’ most common ones, at the top of the list.
  • Phone number validation with the phone number rules of each country. When a number is not valid: stop the order, only warn, or don’t check.
  • The same check runs when the order is placed, even if the check under the field didn’t run.
  • An empty optional phone field is never blocked. Dialtidy follows the WooCommerce setting for the phone field.
  • Orders paid with express payment buttons (digital wallets) are not stopped because of the phone, when the payment plugin marks them as express payments.
  • Short, clear messages under the field, in your site’s language when a translation is available.
  • The country list works with the keyboard and has labels for screen readers.
  • Compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Compatibility

  • Dialtidy attaches to WooCommerce’s own phone fields. It is tested with the default WordPress themes, block and classic.
  • Phone fields added by other plugins and forms are not changed.
  • Orders you create in the admin are not changed.

Dialtidy Pro

A paid add-on for shops that want to fix the phone numbers they already have and work with them in their orders. Everything in Dialtidy, plus:

✔ Old numbers fixed in bulk, with undo — every number in your past orders and customer accounts, as it is and as it will be, fixed when you click.

✔ Wrong numbers marked in your orders — the order screen shows what is wrong and fixes the number with one click.

✔ Call, WhatsApp, SMS or copy from the order — buttons under the phone number on the order screen and in the order preview.

✔ Find an order by phone number — typed in international format or in your country’s national format.

✔ Mobile numbers only, and exact messages — for example “This number is too short for Austria. Please check it.”

✔ An email asking for a missing phone number — for orders paid with Apple Pay or Google Pay that arrive without one.

And many more features: see the full list of Dialtidy Pro features →

More

Setup guide, screenshots and how we test: wedoingood.com/plugins/dialtidy. We build WooCommerce plugins as shop owners, from problems we hit in our own shop.

External services

Dialtidy does not connect to any external service. The flags, the country list and the phone number rules are part of the plugin.

Credits

Dialtidy includes these open-source libraries:

  • intl-tel-input 29.5.4 by Jack O’Connor, MIT License – the country picker with flags. Bundled as the minified build; the readable source is at https://github.com/jackocnr/intl-tel-input/tree/v29.5.4 and the unminified build is dist/js/intlTelInputWithUtils.js in the npm package intl-tel-input@29.5.4.
  • libphonenumber-for-php 8.13.55 by Joshua Gigg, Apache License 2.0 – the phone number rules, with the phone number data of version 9.0.41. Source: https://github.com/giggsey/libphonenumber-for-php. The namespace is changed and the data is written in the format of version 8.13, see vendor/libphonenumber/README.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Dialtidy. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Dialtidy to choose countries and what happens when a number is not valid.
  3. Open your checkout: the phone field now has a flag.
sections.faq:
Where do I find Dialtidy after installing it?

In the admin menu, go to WooCommerce → Dialtidy. You can also click “Settings” under the plugin’s name on the Plugins screen.

Which phone fields get a flag?

The billing and shipping phone in the block checkout and the classic checkout, and the billing and shipping address in My account.

How are numbers saved?

In international format with the country code, for example +12015550123, even when the customer typed (201) 555-0123. On the order screen it is shown with spaces, for example +1 201-555-0123; the saved number stays the same. Numbers that are already in your orders are not changed.

How does the phone number validation work?

Dialtidy checks the number against the phone number rules of its country, which come with the plugin (libphonenumber): its length and the number ranges that country uses. The check runs under the field before the order is placed, and again when the order is placed. You choose what happens when a number is not valid: stop the order, only warn, or don’t check.

What if a customer has a phone number from another country?

The customer picks that country in the list, or types the number with + and the country code. You can limit which countries each phone field accepts under WooCommerce → Dialtidy.

Is the phone field required?

Dialtidy follows the WooCommerce setting, and an empty optional phone is never blocked. To change the setting, edit the Checkout page and select the Checkout block: the phone field option is in the block settings. With the classic checkout, it is under Appearance → Customize → WooCommerce → Checkout.

What does “Only warn” do?

The customer sees a hint under the field but can still place the order. The number is saved in international format when it is valid, and as typed when it is not.

Does Dialtidy stop orders paid with express payment buttons?

No. With express payment buttons (digital wallets), the phone comes from the customer’s wallet, not from the phone field. Dialtidy saves it in international format when it can and does not stop such an order. Express buttons of WooCommerce Stripe Gateway and WooPayments are recognized; developers can add others with the dialtidy_express_gateways filter.

Does it need anything on my server?

WordPress 6.6, WooCommerce 9.6 and PHP 7.4 or newer. Full number rules need PHP’s mbstring extension, which almost every host has. Without it, Dialtidy checks the length of the number and adds the address’s country code to numbers typed without one; your country lists still apply, and a country code shared by several countries (such as +1 or +7) counts as any of them.

Can developers change the messages or which numbers are accepted?

Yes, with filters: dialtidy_message (the message for a number that is not accepted), dialtidy_allowed_types (for example mobile numbers only), dialtidy_script_config (messages in the browser and spaces while typing), dialtidy_display_phone (how a number is shown on the order screen), dialtidy_is_express_payment and dialtidy_express_gateways.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings are removed. Phone numbers in your orders and customer accounts stay as they are.

Is there a paid version?

Yes: Dialtidy Pro, a separate add-on that runs next to the free plugin. It fixes the phone numbers you already have and helps you work with them in your orders. The free plugin stays complete on its own. What Pro adds

How do I report a security issue?

Please email office@wedoingood.com and do not post it in the support forum. We confirm the report, fix it and release an update.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • New name: Dialtidy – International Phone Number Field & Validation for WooCommerce.
  • Readme: a clearer short description and the question “How does the phone number validation work?”.
  • No changes to the checkout or to how numbers are saved.

1.4.1

  • Security hardening.
  • Express payment buttons are recognized for WooCommerce Stripe Gateway and WooPayments.
  • An express order whose phone number does not meet the phone rules gets a private note.
  • Developers: new filter dialtidy_express_gateways; dialtidy_is_express_payment also gets the payment method.

1.4.0

  • Short notes about Dialtidy Pro on Dialtidy’s own screen only: a card on the Settings tab with five Pro features and a link to the full list, and a “Dialtidy Pro” tab listing what the add-on does, each with a picture. “Hide Pro notes” hides them until your next log-in. They are not shown while Dialtidy Pro is active, and the dialtidy_show_pro_notes filter turns them off. Nothing is loaded from the internet and nothing is sent.
  • Readme: a section about Dialtidy Pro and the question “Is there a paid version?”.
  • No changes to the checkout or to how numbers are saved.

Older versions: see changelog.txt.

short_description: Phone number validation for the WooCommerce checkout: a phone field with country flags, and numbers saved in international format.
